input.quote: (a) Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
input.rationale: Section 10(a) gives us a broad Vendor-side defence and indemnity covering third-party Claims arising out of the Services, the Auction Platform, the Creative served through it, Kubient's breach of its representations and warranties (which include its ownership of all IP in the Service and Auction Platform (p0039–p0040) and its compliance with applicable Law (p0041)), and the acts or omissions of Kubient and its subcontractors. Because it captures any third-party Claim "arising out of or in connection with" the Services and Platform, it covers IP infringement/misappropriation allegations, unlawful conduct and Kubient's misconduct, so it meets (indeed exceeds) the preferred position, with no super-cap needed. Section 11 supplies the standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and the liability cap in Section 9(a) expressly carves out indemnification liability. Minor note only, not a deviation: our own indemnity in Section 10(b) is mirrored rather than strictly limited to Customer Content/Properties and breach of law (it also reaches misuse of the Services/Platform and Customer's acts or omissions); that is customary reciprocal drafting and does not undercut the Vendor indemnity, so we do not redline it.
